faq.q: How does AI customer service work for property and real estate businesses?
faq.a: Cekat.AI connects to your WhatsApp, Instagram, and website chat, then answers property inquiries instantly using knowledge you provide, listings, prices, locations, payment schemes. It qualifies each lead, schedules site visits, follows up automatically, and records everything in a CRM pipeline, working 24/7 alongside your sales team.

faq.q: Can the AI qualify property leads coming from ads?
faq.a: Yes. When someone clicks your ad and starts a chat, the AI responds in seconds, asks qualifying questions, budget, location, unit type, and saves the answers to a CRM card automatically. Cekat.AI also integrates CAPI with Meta and TikTok, sending better signal quality back to your ad platforms so campaigns improve over time.

faq.q: Can prospects schedule a property visit through the chat?
faq.a: Yes. Through API integration with your scheduling system, the AI books, confirms, and reschedules property visits directly inside the conversation, and automated reminders go out before the appointment, so more prospects who book a visit actually arrive at the show unit.

faq.q: What happens to leads who go quiet after asking about a unit?
faq.a: Cekat.AI follows up automatically. Workflow triggers based on time, chat keywords, or customer-data changes send the right nudge at the right moment, a reminder before a promo ends, a check-in after a site visit, so leads re-engage without an agent having to remember each one.

faq.q: When does a human agent take over the conversation?
faq.a: Whenever negotiation or a complex request needs a person, the conversation escalates to your team with the full chat history attached. With AI working hours, your agents handle chats during online hours and the AI covers everything after, the handoff is automatic and carries complete context.

faq.q: Can I track my sales pipeline in Cekat.AI?
faq.a: Yes. Every lead moves through Customer Stages, Visitor, Lead, Buyer, with next-step suggestions, and the sales pipeline shows real-time progress on every deal. Filters and boards let you slice by project, agent, or stage, so nothing sits unnoticed.

faq.q: Which channels can a property business connect?
faq.a: WhatsApp (official Business API), Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, website live chat, and API channels, all flowing into one unified inbox with a single interaction history per prospect, so a lead who moves from Instagram to WhatsApp never has to repeat themselves.

faq.q: What results have property companies seen with Cekat.AI?
faq.a: Threeland Property grew revenue by more than 50% after implementing Cekat.AI. Its president director credits the platform with securing property visits and closing deals even while he sleeps, because no leads are missed at any hour.

faq.q: How long does it take to set up for a property business?
faq.a: Building the AI agent takes around five minutes, paste your project information, price lists, and SOPs into the knowledge base, and it starts answering accurately. No coding is required; Cekat.AI describes it as being as easy as briefing a CS admin.
